breve: A custom shader program with a visual editor.
descricao: This class provides a graph-like visual editor for creating a Shader. Although VisualShaders do not require coding, they share the same logic with script shaders. They use VisualShaderNodes that can be connected to each other to control the flow of the shader. The visual shader graph is converted to a script shader behind the scenes.

metodos.assinatura: add_node(type: VisualShader.Type, node: VisualShaderNode, position: Vector2, id: int) -> void
metodos.desc: Adds the specified 'node' to the shader.

metodos.assinatura: add_varying(name: String, mode: VisualShader.VaryingMode, type: VisualShader.VaryingType) -> void
metodos.desc: Adds a new varying value node to the shader.

metodos.assinatura: attach_node_to_frame(type: VisualShader.Type, id: int, frame: int) -> void
metodos.desc: Attaches the given node to the given frame.

metodos.assinatura: can_connect_nodes(type: VisualShader.Type, from_node: int, from_port: int, to_node: int, to_port: int) -> bool const
metodos.desc: Returns true if the specified nodes and ports can be connected together.

metodos.assinatura: connect_nodes(type: VisualShader.Type, from_node: int, from_port: int, to_node: int, to_port: int) -> Error
metodos.desc: Connects the specified nodes and ports.

metodos.assinatura: connect_nodes_forced(type: VisualShader.Type, from_node: int, from_port: int, to_node: int, to_port: int) -> void
metodos.desc: Connects the specified nodes and ports, even if they can't be connected. Such connection is invalid and will not function properly.

metodos.assinatura: detach_node_from_frame(type: VisualShader.Type, id: int) -> void
metodos.desc: Detaches the given node from the frame it is attached to.

metodos.assinatura: disconnect_nodes(type: VisualShader.Type, from_node: int, from_port: int, to_node: int, to_port: int) -> void
metodos.desc: Connects the specified nodes and ports.

metodos.assinatura: get_node(type: VisualShader.Type, id: int) -> VisualShaderNode const
metodos.desc: Returns the shader node instance with specified 'type' and 'id'.

metodos.assinatura: get_node_connections(type: VisualShader.Type) -> Dictionary[] const
metodos.desc: Returns the list of connected nodes with the specified type.

metodos.assinatura: get_node_list(type: VisualShader.Type) -> PackedInt32Array const
metodos.desc: Returns the list of all nodes in the shader with the specified type.

metodos.assinatura: get_node_position(type: VisualShader.Type, id: int) -> Vector2 const
metodos.desc: Returns the position of the specified node within the shader graph.

metodos.assinatura: get_valid_node_id(type: VisualShader.Type) -> int const
metodos.desc: Returns next valid node ID that can be added to the shader graph.

metodos.assinatura: has_varying(name: String) -> bool const
metodos.desc: Returns true if the shader has a varying with the given 'name'.

metodos.assinatura: is_node_connection(type: VisualShader.Type, from_node: int, from_port: int, to_node: int, to_port: int) -> bool const
metodos.desc: Returns true if the specified node and port connection exist.

metodos.assinatura: remove_node(type: VisualShader.Type, id: int) -> void
metodos.desc: Removes the specified node from the shader.

metodos.assinatura: remove_varying(name: String) -> void
metodos.desc: Removes a varying value node with the given 'name'. Prints an error if a node with this name is not found.

metodos.assinatura: replace_node(type: VisualShader.Type, id: int, new_class: StringName) -> void
metodos.desc: Replaces the specified node with a node of new class type.

metodos.assinatura: set_mode(mode: Shader.Mode) -> void
metodos.desc: Sets the mode of this shader.

metodos.assinatura: set_node_position(type: VisualShader.Type, id: int, position: Vector2) -> void
metodos.desc: Sets the position of the specified node.
